d.ko: A satirical life-and-money sim. One turn is one month: budget your hours, work the job, ride the market, outlive inflation and your own decisions. Pick a character and make their dream come true. Or at least don't die trying.
d.en: A satirical life-and-money sim. One turn is one month: budget your hours, work the job, ride the market, outlive inflation and your own decisions. Pick a character and make their dream come true. Or at least don't die trying.
d.zh: 讽刺风格的人生理财模拟器。一回合就是一个月：分配时间，上班挣钱，进出股市，在通胀和自己的决定里活下来。选一个角色，帮他圆梦。至少，别死在半路上。
